integrations/dotnet-aspnet.title: .NET 8 (ASP.NET Core Minimal API)
integrations/dotnet-aspnet.description: Use the official PrimusSaaS.Identity.Validator package to validate Azure AD and LocalAuth tokens in the same pipeline.

integrations/java-spring-boot.title: Java (Spring Boot Resource Server)
integrations/java-spring-boot.description: Secure Spring Boot APIs with Azure AD and LocalAuth using the built-in OAuth2 resource server plus an AuthenticationManagerResolver to route tokens by issuer.

integrations/node-express.title: Node.js (Express) Integration
integrations/node-express.description: This guide shows you how to integrate Primus SaaS modules with your Express.js application.

integrations/overview.title: Integration Overview
integrations/overview.description: Primus authenticates requests by routing JWT/OIDC tokens to the correct issuer based on the iss claim, validating signatures, audiences, lifetimes, and then attaching a normalized PrimusUser to the request context.

intro.title: Primus Integration Hub
intro.description: Primus lets you validate tokens from multiple issuers (Azure AD, LocalAuth, custom JWT) with the same middleware and claims model. Use these guides to get a working API in minutes and share them externally as your public integration playbook.
